description: Clean code is code that people can read and change with confidence. We will improve small JavaScript examples by naming things clearly, keeping jobs small and making assumptions visible. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain keep one job in a function
Explain return early for simple cases

seo.title: Clean Code Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Clean Code with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
